 versus
 State Of Nct Of Delhi And Anr.

Through: Mr  wi  In  Sp  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 30.01.2026 CRL.M.A. 3169/2026 (lengthy synopsis and list of dates)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
CRL.M.C. 806/2026 & CRL.M.A. 3168/2026 (stay)
2.
Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 246/2024 of Police Station Patparganj Industrial Area for offence under Section 498A/406/323/354/376/377/506/34 IPC on merits.
3. Petitioners are brothers-in-law (brothers of husband of complainant de facto) and it is contended that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2 herein) is a practicing advocate.

Learned counsel for petitioners has taken me through record, contending that the complaint of offences alleged against the petitioners is completely unbelievable and total abuse of process.
4.
Learned APP accepts notice and seeks and is allowed four weeks to file status report.
Notice be also issued to respondent no.2 through IO.
This is a digitally signed order.
